newsitem.title: SWEDEN: OM /IBM work on electronic trading system.
newsitem.headline: OM /IBM work on electronic trading system.

text.p: Swedish option broker OM Gruppen AB on Wednesday said it had signed an agreement with IBM relating to the development of an electronic trading system.
"The purpose of the venture is to find efficient solutions for the financial markets of today and tomorrow," OM said in a statement.
It said the OM CLICK exchange system would now be offered on IBM's RS/6000 servers.

"By combining OM's transaction technology with IBM's open systems technology, the requirements of stock exchanges for immediate, cost-efficient and secure transaction handling will be satisfied," OM said.
It said a prototype of a future trading system would be presented at a trade fair in Chicago later on Wednesday.
